question: Cyclone-30, a particle accelerator is used in medical application. It will help patients suffering from ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Cancer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cyclone-30** is a particle accelerator developed by the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE).
 
• It is primarily used for the production of radioisotopes for medical applications.
 
• These radioisotopes are used in the diagnosis and treatment of **cancer**.
 
• It enables the production of isotopes like Fluorine-18, which is critical for PET scans in oncology.
